Case: Douglas is a 39-year-old with lung cancer status-post chemo and radiation therapy who presents with sharp thoracic pain. Douglas states that his pain started 3 days ago and has progressed significantly to the point he can't sleep. Douglas's pain is primarily along the lateral aspects of his and his sternum. Ibuprofen and acetaminophen have provided minimal relief, and he endorses that the pain is sharper and worse during deep inspiration. Douglas's physical exam is remarkable for severe tenderness to palpation of his sternum and lateral rib cage.
